[[File:The Lord of the Rings The Card Game original 2011 logo.png|thumb|Original The Lord of the Rings: The Card Game logo.]]
'''The Lord of the Rings: The Card Game''' is a cooperative Living Card Game designed by Nate French and first published by Fantasy Flight Games in April 2011.<ref name="core">[https://images-cdn.fantasyflightgames.com/ffg_content/lotr-lcg/LOTR%20Rules.pdf The Lord of the Rings: The Card Game Rules of Play], Fantasy Flight Games, credits. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20260604185405/https://images-cdn.fantasyflightgames.com/ffg_content/lotr-lcg/LOTR%20Rules.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref>[https://talesfromthecards.wordpress.com/2013/07/17/interview-caleb-grace-lead-developer/ Interview: Caleb Grace, Lead Developer], Tales from the Cards, 17 July 2013. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20230320223632/https://talesfromthecards.wordpress.com/2013/07/17/interview-caleb-grace-lead-developer/ Internet Archive].</ref>

== Gameplay ==

Players lead a fellowship and bring decks of heroes, allies, attachments, and events to a shared quest. An encounter deck supplies enemies, locations, and treacheries. Scenarios define the objectives, and players cooperate to complete them. Expansions are sold in fixed sets.<ref name="core" /><ref>[https://www.fantasyflightgames.com/en/products/the-lord-of-the-rings-the-card-game/ The Lord of the Rings: The Card Game], Fantasy Flight Games product catalog. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20260316054518/https://www.fantasyflightgames.com/en/products/the-lord-of-the-rings-the-card-game/ Internet Archive].</ref>

== Publication ==

Fantasy Flight Games released the Revised Core Set in 2022, then repackaged selected expansions. ''The Return of the King Saga Expansion'', the last of the repackaged expansions, was released on 4 October 2024.<ref>[https://www.fantasyflightgames.com/en/news/2023/1/31/the-journey-so-far/ The Journey So Far], Fantasy Flight Games, 31 January 2023. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20250716205511/https://www.fantasyflightgames.com/en/news/2023/1/31/the-journey-so-far/ Internet Archive].</ref><ref>[https://www.fantasyflightgames.com/en/news/2024/7/18/the-fate-of-middle-earth/ The Fate of Middle-earth], Fantasy Flight Games, 18 July 2024. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20260427193703/https://www.fantasyflightgames.com/en/news/2024/7/18/the-fate-of-middle-earth/ Internet Archive].</ref><ref>[https://www.fantasyflightgames.com/en/news/2024/10/4/available-now-october-4-1/ Available Now: October 4], Fantasy Flight Games, 4 October 2024. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20250428081127/https://www.fantasyflightgames.com/en/news/2024/10/4/available-now-october-4-1/ Internet Archive].</ref>

== Online play ==

The [[TCGMix]] playtest includes all three Revised Core adventures, playable individually or as part of the Mirkwood Paths campaign.<ref name="catalog" />

Players can [https://tcgmix.com/lotrlcg/ open the game on TCGMix].<ref name="tcgmix-play-the-lord-of-the-rings-lcg">[https://tcgmix.com/lotrlcg/ Play The Lord of the Rings LCG], TCGMix. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261107195038/https://tcgmix.com/lotrlcg/ Internet Archive].</ref>
